serotype_evidence.value: Pathogen: clinical or host-associated sample from Shigella sonnei
Reference-grade genome from FDA ARGOS BioProject PRJNA231221

curation.notes: FDA ARGOS isolate FDAARGOS_715. Species Shigella sonnei from organism name. Serotype subtype not in metadata - ShigaTyper required for complete typing. ipaH gene must be present for Shigella confirmation.

mlst.notes: Shigella uses E. coli MLST scheme

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRS4857653 && mv data/SRS4857653_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRS4857653_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.download_cmd: datasets download genome accession GCF_009729995.1 --filename data/FDAARGOS_715.zip && unzip -j data/FDAARGOS_715.zip '*.fna' -d data/ && mv data/*.fna data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.species_confirmation: Expected species: Shigella sonnei. Tool must detect ipaH gene. Accept species-level match - serotype subtype determined by ShigaTyper.

notes: FDA ARGOS Shigella sonnei isolate. S. sonnei is monomorphic (ST152 dominant). Run ShigaTyper to determine complete serotype.
